name: Osananajimi na Kanojo
source:
Main character has a female childhood friend who can not convey her feelings. Their parents go together on a trip leaving kids to take care of each other under one roof. How will young people change during this week?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公有一位无法传达心意的青梅竹马。双方父母结伴旅行，留下两人在同一屋檐下照应彼此。年轻的两人会在这一周里如何改变？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
